description: Score every discovered post against relevancy rules and delete the irrelevant ones (kept when dry_run:true). Costs 2 credits per post reviewed — dry runs are billed too, since the AI review runs either way. Start with dry_run:true to preview the verdicts, then re-run with dry_run:false to prune. Confirm the spend with the user.

dry_run.description: Preview verdicts without deleting (default false; still billed)

review_rules.description: Relevancy rules, e.g. 'Keep only posts where the author has a real problem our product solves'. Falls back to rules saved on the campaign.

name: review_posts
title: AI-review posts for relevance
